## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dew-uff/speedupy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] The issue is linked above and the solution was agreed there
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix starts with the test that reproduces it)
- [ ] `MIN_TESTS` is raised, if tests were added
- [ ] `ruff format --check` and `ruff check` are clean
- [ ] The server tests were run, if a storage changed
- [ ] The documents are updated
- [ ] No em dashes
